name: LoL Spirit Blossom Cursor
creator: kayisei-exe-0
description:
⚠️ Important — Legacy Cursor Required

This mod is designed specifically for League of Legends' Legacy Cursor.

To enable it:

Enter a game.

Open Settings → Interface.

Enable Legacy Cursor.

The mod may not display correctly with the modern cursor enabled.


🌸 Credits & Disclaimer

This is an unofficial, fan-made cursor modification featuring AI-assisted artwork inspired by Riot Games' Spirit Blossom universe.

This project is not affiliated with or endorsed by Riot Games.

✨ What's Included

The pack replaces six in-game cursor elements:

Main Cursor

Hover Enemy

Hover Friendly

Hover Use

Shop Cursor

Single Target

Each cursor is designed to complement the others while preserving its original in-game purpose.

🌸 Spirit Blossom Cursor Pack

Bring the enchanting atmosphere of Spirit Blossom to your League of Legends experience with a complete custom cursor collection.
